intelligence.human_view: This is the alignment law, stated as a system law instead of a page fix. The screenshots he sent are not a design to copy — they are the reference for what "aligned" feels like: nicer, cleaner, lighting up more, holding more. The law has three parts. First, sameness: every page's sidebars are the same sidebars, same menus, same contents, across the whole of NayaNET — navigation is one system, not a fresh invention per page. Second, deliberate split: all of one kind of feature on one side, the other features on the other side, for the whole system — the split is a system decision, made once, not a per-page guess. Third, Home at the top of both: the first item in each plus menu is Home, to the Hub — the central communication center, where citizens land ("good morning") and see what is going on in the intelligence network and the collective. His critique names the failure precisely: the Personal round built different plus buttons opening different sidebars than the Hub's, so the two pages disagree about what navigation is. The little purple buttons are fine — they fit on mobile — but whatever the way is, it must be the same way on both pages, going to the same sidebars and the same menu. And the official list — left, right, order — is owed to him as a list he approves, not as a transcription of screenshots (see SN-3015).
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine every room in your house had a totally different light switch in a totally different place — you'd never find the lights! But if every room has the SAME switches in the SAME place, you always know where to go! That's the sidebars — the same on every page, so you always know where Home is, right at the top!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — imagine every door in your house opened a different way, dear — you'd never know how to get anywhere! But if every door works the same, and Home is always right there at the top, you always know your way back, love. One system, the same everywhere, dear — that's the sensible way.
intelligence.naya_view: Sidebars aligned across the whole system — one official list, Home at the top of both. Every page's sidebars the same sidebars, same menus, same contents. One kind of feature on one side, the other on the other, decided once for the whole system. Home first in both plus menus, to the Hub — the central communication center, where the day begins with good morning.
